cat > parking.py <<'E'
FREE_MINUTES = 30
RATE_PER_HOUR = 2


def fee(minutes: int) -> int:
    if minutes <= FREE_MINUTES:
        return 0
    started_hours = -(-minutes // 60)
    return RATE_PER_HOUR * started_hours
E
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -3
git add parking.py tests/test_parking.py; git commit -qm "Add the parking fee" -m "" --trailer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'
cat >> tests/test_parking.py <<'E'


def test_exactly_30_minutes_is_free():
    assert fee(30) == 0


def test_31_minutes_costs_one_started_hour():
    assert fee(31) == 2


def test_a_whole_hour_costs_one_hour():
    assert fee(60) == 2


def test_one_minute_over_an_hour_starts_a_second_hour():
    assert fee(61) == 4
E
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -3
git commit -qam "Test fee boundaries" -m "" --trailer 'Mutant-step: task 1 input shape' --trailer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'

mk 1 's/minutes <= FREE/minutes < FREE/'
